readme:
# Wallapop Scraper

Search Wallapop, the second-hand marketplace, by keyword and location and get structured listings: title, description, price, photos, category, location, seller id and dates. It works for Spain and also for Italy and Portugal, because Wallapop serves all three markets from the same search.

You pay per listing. There is no monthly fee.

## What you can do with it

- Track the asking prices of a product (phones, bikes, furniture, cars parts) in a city.
- Find new listings first by sorting on newest.
- Collect price ranges per category for market research or resale.
- Feed listings into a spreadsheet, a database or a price alert.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `keywords` | list of text | One search per keyword. Required for a real run. |
| `location` | text | City name. The 20 largest Spanish cities are built in (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Sevilla, Zaragoza, Malaga, Murcia, Palma, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Bilbao, Alicante, Cordoba, Valladolid, Vigo, Gijon, L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Vitoria-Gasteiz, A Coruna, Elche, Granada), plus Milano, Roma, Lisboa and Porto. Default: Madrid. |
| `latitude`, `longitude` | number | Search around any point. When both are set they replace `location`. |
| `minPrice`, `maxPrice` | number | Price range filter. |
| `categoryId` | integer | Wallapop category id. Every result row shows its `category_id`. |
| `orderBy` | text | `relevance` (default), `newest`, `closest`, `price_low_to_high` or `price_high_to_low`. |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Listings per keyword. Default 50, maximum 1000. One page holds 40 listings. |

An empty input runs a small demo: the keyword "bicicleta" around Madrid, 5 listings.

Example, two keywords around Madrid:

```json
{
  "keywords": ["iphone", "bicicleta"],
  "latitude": 40.4168,
  "longitude": -3.7038,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 60
}
```

Example, newest bikes in Milan between 50 and 300 euros:

```json
{
  "keywords": ["bicicleta"],
  "location": "Milano",
  "minPrice": 50,
  "maxPrice": 300,
  "orderBy": "newest",
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 45
}
```

A listing that matches several keywords is delivered once.

## Output

One row per listing. Fields without a value are `null`.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `item_id`, `url`, `web_slug` | Listing id and the link to its page |
| `title`, `description` | Text written by the seller |
| `price`, `currency` | Asking price |
| `previous_price`, `discount_percentage` | Shown when the seller lowered the price |
| `category_id`, `category`, `category_path` | Category of the listing |
| `city`, `region`, `province`, `postal_code`, `country_code`, `latitude`, `longitude` | Where the item is |
| `images`, `image_count`, `thumbnail` | Photo links |
| `reserved`, `shippable`, `seller_allows_shipping` | Listing state and shipping options |
| `promotion_type`, `is_refurbished`, `has_warranty`, `seller_is_top_profile` | Badges shown on the listing |
| `seller_id` | The public seller id shown by Wallapop. No other seller data is collected. |
| `created_at`, `modified_at` | Dates in ISO 8601, UTC |
| `search_query`, `page`, `scraped_at` | Which search found it and when |

Output sample:

```json
{
  "item_id": "nz085ored76o",
  "url": "https://es.wallapop.com/item/iphone-xr-negro-1319249375",
  "title": "iPhone XR Negro",
  "price": 80,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "category": "Smartphones",
  "category_path": ["Technology & electronics", "Phones: mobiles & smartwatches", "Smartphones"],
  "city": "Madrid",
  "region": "Comunidad de Madrid",
  "postal_code": "28014",
  "country_code": "ES",
  "image_count": 4,
  "reserved": false,
  "shippable": true,
  "seller_id": "pzp9kglx5m63",
  "created_at": "2026-11-01T03:36:15Z",
  "modified_at": "2026-11-05T10:24:14Z",
  "search_query": "iphone",
  "page": 1
}
```

## Pricing

You pay for two events.

| Event name | When it is charged | Price |
|---|---|---|
| `actor-start` | Once per run, together with the first delivered listing | $0.001 per run |
| `wallapop-item-result` | For each listing delivered | $0.0003 per listing ($0.30 per 1,000) |

A run that finds nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost for the run, the actor stops cleanly when the limit is reached and keeps the listings already delivered.

## FAQ

**Which countries work?**
Spain, Italy and Portugal. The country of the results follows the location you search around. Results near a border can include listings from the neighbouring market.

**How many listings can I get per keyword?**
Up to 1000 per keyword. Wallapop returns 40 per page, and the actor follows the pages until your limit or the end of the results.

**Does it return seller names or contact details?**
No. Only the public seller id shown with the listing.

**Why did I get fewer listings than I asked for?**
The search may have fewer matches, or the price and category filters narrowed it. The run status message says how many listings were delivered.

**Is a rerun going to repeat listings?**
Each run is independent. Within one run a listing is delivered once, and a run that is moved to another machine continues without repeating listings or charges.

**What does the run status say when something goes wrong?**
If Wallapop refuses all requests, the run ends with an error and a clear message, and nothing is charged. A search with no matches ends normally with the message "No listings found for this search".

**Can I use the category id from a result?**
Yes. Copy `category_id` from any row into the `categoryId` input to search inside that category.
